Title: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
![Image 1](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50331017&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50330456)The same Apollo Global Research partner, Torsten Slok, also published this widely cited story in September 2025 last year, "AI Adoption Rate Trending Down for Large Companies": [https://www.apolloacademy.com/ai-adoption-rate-trending-down...](https://www.apolloacademy.com/ai-adoption-rat
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Apollo的Torsten Slok称AI给多数公司带来零财务回报，并引用美国人口普查局对120万家企业的双周调查显示250人以上公司AI采用率下降。

en.reason: Apollo's Torsten Slok says AI delivers zero financial payoff to most companies, citing a U.S. Census Bureau biweekly survey of 1.2 million businesses that shows adoption falling at firms with 250+ employees.

en.title: Minecraft's AI agent colony fails to build a civilization, getting mired in bureaucracy instead
en.reason: A Minecraft experiment in which AI agents attempted to build a civilization failed, with the agents bogged down in bureaucracy, in a test meant to offer insight into recent AI agent headlines.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Brazilian court 对两名律师罚款约 $16,000，因他们在提交给 Galileu 的法院文件中用白字白底隐藏 prompt injection，要求 AI 敷衍回应且不质疑文件；这可能是全球首例针对此类操纵的司法裁决。

en.reason: A Brazilian labor court fined two lawyers about $16,000 for hiding a white-on-white prompt injection in a filing that told the court’s Galileu AI to go easy on their case, possibly the first such judicial ruling.
